tickets.title: Prepare estate attorney outline of account and beneficiary information
tickets.text: Prepare an outline of Daniel Copperwisp’s account and beneficiary details for his estate attorney, summarizing current trust, brokerage, IRA, and retirement assets to facilitate updates. Include the existing beneficiary designations and any gaps identified during the review.
tickets.evidence: Mira’s review found Daniel’s trust and fiduciary appointments were drafted before the marriage, and Daniel asked for an outline of the account and beneficiary information his estate attorney would need to evaluate updates; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-01-15.

tickets.title: Obtain legal identification and marriage certificate
tickets.text: Obtain from Daniel Copperwisp his spouse Lea’s full legal identifying information and a copy of their marriage certificate to enable the custodian to complete household and beneficiary record updates.
tickets.evidence: The custodian cannot complete the requested household and beneficiary record updates from the conversation alone because Daniel has not yet provided Lea’s full legal identifying information or a copy of the marriage certificate;

tickets.title: Resolve beneficiary record discrepancies
tickets.text: Resolve the beneficiary‑record issue for Daniel Copperwisp by updating the IRA beneficiary from Owen to Lea and adding a transfer‑on‑death beneficiary to the taxable brokerage account as identified.
tickets.evidence: During the account review, Mira noted that Daniel described Lea as his intended primary beneficiary, while the IRA record still lists Owen and the taxable account has no transfer-on-death beneficiary on file; resolving the beneficiary-record issue remains needed by 2025-01-09.

tickets.title: Prepare investment income and tax filing summary
tickets.text: Prepare a concise summary for Daniel Copperwisp outlining investment income, potential capital‑gain exposure, withholding information, and filing‑status questions to support his discussion with his CPA.
tickets.evidence: Daniel wanted Apricot Compass Advisory to prepare a concise summary of investment income, potential capital-gain exposure, withholding information, and filing-status questions for that discussion; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-01-10.
